name: Dining room
fixed: Wall to kitchen at left, load path unconfirmed
description: Dining room. Wood plank ceiling, white plaster walls. Centered patterned cement-tile panel on the back wall behind a long wood table with six bentwood rattan chairs. Three woven pendants over the table. Big glass slider to the garden on the right. Chevron wood floor. Kitchen is behind the left wall; you reach it through a hall door.
